CustomField.description: The API value of the Gift Transaction Status that means paid in this org, written on each Gift Transaction the Gift Transaction mirror creates. Empty reads as Paid. A value the org's Status list does not have active stops the mirror until it is corrected.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: The Status your paid Gift Transactions have, exactly as its API name. Nothing is copied while it is not one of your org's active Status values.
CustomField.label: Gift Transaction Mirror Status
